description: The nth Perrin number. R0 is 3, R1 is 0, R2 is 2, and later terms use the Padovan recurrence. An optional modulus reduces the term, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 8192. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perrin
